title: Enhancing Clinical Decision-Making: Integrating Multi-Agent Systems with Ethical AI Governance
reasoning: The paper features 'Ethical AI Governance' as a core component of its proposed architecture. It includes a dedicated 'Transparency Agent' designed to ensure ethical standards like explainability and traceability. Furthermore, it defines and evaluates a quantitative 'transparency score' to benchmark the ethical performance of the multi-agent system against a single-agent baseline.
